@@ -6,24 +6,32 @@
 # checker). Fixpoint-locked against `Rian.Check.infer` in
 # `test/rian/checker_infer_fixpoint_test.exs`.
 #
-# Inference rules (ADR-0064): an integer literal is `Int53`, a string `String`,
-# `true`/`false` `Bool`; unary `-` passes the operand type through and `not` is
-# `Bool`; a binary op's result is determined by the op — comparisons/`and`/`or`
-# are `Bool`, `<>` is `String`, `/` is `Float64`, and `+ - * div rem` over
-# integers are `Int53`. An unbound identifier is `unknown` — the checker is
-# deliberately conservative and does NOT guess.
+# Inference rules (ADR-0064): a numeric literal is `Int53`, or `Float64` if it
+# carries a `.`/`e`/`E`; a string is `String`, a char `Char`, `true`/`false` `Bool`;
+# unary `-` passes the operand type through and `not` is `Bool`; a binary op's result
+# is determined by the op — comparisons/`and`/`or` are `Bool`, `<>` is `String`, `/`
+# is `Float64`, and `+ - * div rem` over integers are `Int53`. The determinate
+# primitive intrinsics infer their result type (`__prim_char_code` → `Int53`,
+# `__prim_int_to_float` → `Float64`, `__prim_str_to_atom` → `Symbol`,
+# `__prim_char_to_string`/`__prim_str_concat_all` → `String`). An unbound identifier
+# or a general (non-prim) call is `unknown` — the checker is deliberately
+# conservative and does NOT guess.
 #
-# Slice: closed integer expressions (no typing environment, no float literals).
-# Variables-in-env, float widths, calls, lambdas, `case`, lists, and the abstract
-# operators are the `:partial` tail — see ADR-0063 / docs/self-host-status.md.
+# Covered Core nodes (7): CNum/CStr/CChar/CId/CUnary/CBin/CCall (closed expressions,
+# no typing environment). The `:partial` tail — a typing env (bound variables,
+# user-function/ctor return types), operand-directed arithmetic widths, lambdas,
+# `if`/`case` LUB-join, lists, and the abstract operators — see ADR-0063 /
+# docs/self-host-status.md.
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 mod SelfhostChecker do
   type Core := CNum(String)
              | CStr(String)
+             | CChar(Int53)
              | CId(String)
              | CUnary(String, Core)
              | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+             | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
 
   # A binary op's result type, keyed by the operator (the integer slice):
   # comparisons/`and`/`or`/`in` -> Bool, `<>` -> String, `/` -> Float64, the
@@ -46,14 +54,45 @@ mod SelfhostChecker do
   def bin_ty("div") := "Int53"
   def bin_ty("rem") := "Int53"
 
+  # A numeric literal: `Float64` if it carries a decimal point or an exponent marker
+  # (`.`/`e`/`E`), else the portable `Int53` (ADR-0064 — mirrors Rian.Check's ENum).
+  def num_ty(t String) String
+  def num_ty(t)
+    if float_mark(Prim.str_chars(t)) do
+      "Float64"
+    else
+      "Int53"
+    end
+  end
+
+  def float_mark(Vec(Int53)) Bool
+  def float_mark([]) := false
+  def float_mark([c | rest])
+    if c == 46 or c == 101 or c == 69 do
+      true
+    else
+      float_mark(rest)
+    end
+  end
+
   # Infer the type of a Core node, returning the type name (or "unknown").
   pub def infer(Core) String
-  pub def infer(CNum(_)) := "Int53"
+  pub def infer(CNum(t)) := num_ty(t)
   pub def infer(CStr(_)) := "String"
+  pub def infer(CChar(_)) := "Char"
   pub def infer(CId("true")) := "Bool"
   pub def infer(CId("false")) := "Bool"
   pub def infer(CId(_)) := "unknown"
   pub def infer(CUnary("not", _)) := "Bool"
   pub def infer(CUnary("-", x)) := infer(x)
   pub def infer(CBin(op, _, _)) := bin_ty(op)
+  # primitive intrinsics with a determinate result type (ADR-0036/0047/0069 — mirrors
+  # Rian.Check's `__prim_*` clauses). A general call has no determinate type without a
+  # typing env (function/ctor return types), so it is conservatively `unknown`.
+  pub def infer(CCall("__prim_char_code", [_])) := "Int53"
+  pub def infer(CCall("__prim_int_to_float", [_])) := "Float64"
+  pub def infer(CCall("__prim_str_to_atom", [_])) := "Symbol"
+  pub def infer(CCall("__prim_char_to_string", [_])) := "String"
+  pub def infer(CCall("__prim_str_concat_all", _)) := "String"
+  pub def infer(CCall(_, _)) := "unknown"
 end
